content.value_statement: Vue 3 APIs can be hard to recall while building components. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise guidance for script setup, reactivity, macros, and built-in Vue patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guides Vue single-file component structure with script setup and TypeScript.
Explains defineProps, defineEmits, defineModel, defineExpose, defineOptions, and defineSlots usage.
Covers ref, shallowRef, computed, watch, watchEffect, lifecycle hooks, and composable patterns.
Summarizes Transition, TransitionGroup, Teleport, Suspense, KeepAlive, v-memo, v-once, and custom directives.
Provides Vue 3.5 preferences, including Composition API and shallowRef guidance.
limitations: Does not install Vue packages or run project commands by itself.
Does not replace official Vue documentation for exhaustive API details.
Examples use generic application routes and must be adapted for each project.
Focuses on Vue 3.5 patterns, not legacy Options API migration details.

use_cases.title: Create Typed Components
use_cases.description: Create TypeScript Vue single-file components with script setup, typed props, typed events, and clear templates.

use_cases.title: Standardize Component APIs
use_cases.description: Apply defineModel, defineSlots, generics, and expose patterns across reusable Vue components.

use_cases.title: Improve Reactive Workflows
use_cases.description: Choose reactivity, watcher, lifecycle, and composable patterns for data loading and UI updates.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Typed Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Vue skill to draft a Vue 3 single-file component with script setup, TypeScript props, typed emits, and a simple template. Explain the main choices.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Options API
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Vue skill to refactor this component from Options API to Composition API with script setup. Preserve behavior and note any reactivity changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Composable
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Vue skill to design a composable that accepts reactive input, returns refs, handles loading and errors, and cleans up watcher effects.

prompt_templates.title: Review Advanced Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Vue skill to review this component for defineModel usage, Suspense boundaries, KeepAlive behavior, and performance risks from deep reactivity.

output_examples.input: User asks for a typed Vue 3 form component.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns a concise component plan, typed prop and event decisions, state handling notes, and validation guidance.

output_examples.input: User asks why a watcher runs too often.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains dependency tracking, flush timing, cleanup behavior, and when to use shallowRef or computed instead.

output_examples.input: User asks how to use Teleport with a modal.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes target placement, lifecycle concerns, focus management, and how to combine Teleport with Transition.

best_practices: Prefer Composition API with script setup and TypeScript for new Vue 3 components.
Use computed for derived values and watchers for side effects.
Return plain objects of refs from composables for destructuring compatibility.
anti_patterns: Using deep reactive objects when shallowRef is enough for performance.
Replacing official project requirements with generic examples from the skill.
Mixing Options API and Composition API without a clear migration reason.

faq.question: What Vue version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It is based on Vue 3.5 guidance from generated Vue documentation references.

faq.question: Can it write full Vue components?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide component structure and patterns, but project-specific styling and APIs still need context.

faq.question: Does it support Options API?
faq.answer: It focuses on Composition API and discourages Options API for new work.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No, it provides reference guidance and examples. It does not execute package managers or project commands.

faq.question: Can it help with composables?
faq.answer: Yes, it covers naming, reactive inputs, watcher cleanup, and returning refs.

faq.question: Is it safe for marketplace use?
faq.answer: The audit found documentation examples and metadata links, not executable shell behavior or malicious instructions.
